The supported-metrics reference specifies Count, Total (Sum), PT1M, and EntityName plus OperationResult dimensions (https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/azure/service-bus-messaging/monitor-service-bus-reference; https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/azure/azure-monitor/reference/supported-metrics/microsoft-servicebus-namespaces-metrics). Grafana Cloud explicitly supports the exact mapped family and pulls Azure-available metrics through the Metrics Batch API (https://grafana.com/docs/grafana-cloud/monitor-infrastructure/monitor-cloud-provider/azure/supported-resource-types/; https://grafana.com/docs/grafana-cloud/monitor-infrastructure/monitor-cloud-provider/azure/collect-azure-serverless/). Neither vendor specifies whether an interval or namespace without a qualifying error returns a zero-valued series or omits it. Exact selector absence therefore proves neither unsupportedness nor forwarding failure. No server fault was induced. Resume with independently observed per-series route/job evidence for the error family or vendor documentation of absent-condition output. No instrument type is inferred from the suffix.
